about_the_game:
Defend. Build. Survive.

Take control of your own spacecraft in this fast-paced top-down shooter and become the guardian of Enfora Star, a remote space station under relentless attack by rogue AI robots. Your mission is clear: protect the station while mastering the art of space combat.

Ship combat

Navigate your vessel around the space station, engaging hostile machines with precision and skill. Maneuver through enemy formations and weapon fire as you defend Enfora Star from multiple angles of attack.

Strategic defense

Transform the battleground by constructing tactical defenses. Deploy walls to create choke points, install automated turrets for additional firepower, and design a defensive network that complements your combat style.

Enfora Star blends arcade shooting action with strategic base building in a distinctive pixel art universe. Each defense mission challenges you to improve both your piloting skills and your tactical planning. How long can you keep Enfora Star operational against the mechanical threat?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows® 10 (32/64-bit)
  • Processor: 1.7 GHz Processor or better
  • Memory: 512 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel® HD Graphics 630
  • Storage: 256 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows® 10 (32/64-bit)/11
  • Processor: 2.5 GHz Processor or better
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce GTX 950
  • Storage: 512 MB available space

short_description: Pilot your space vessel in this action-packed space shooter. Defend your station using various weapons, power-ups, and turrets. Balance fast-paced dogfighting with smart fortification as you face waves of enemies in this arcade blend of quick combat and thoughtful planning.
